filename: Black beetle damage in a young palm.png
description: Black beetle Oryctes rhinoceros damage in young coconut palm. Wedge-shaped triangular cuts on fronds, V-shaped symmetrical cuts on leaves, damaged central shoot spindle leaf, hole at the base of frond crown. Rhinoceros beetle pest control and field symptoms.
caption: Characteristic V-shaped leaf cuts and crown damage caused by Black Beetle (Oryctes rhinoceros).
source: CRI Advisory Circular A2: Rhinoceros Beetle Management

caption: Field symptoms of Black Beetle damage showing fan-cut fronds and bore holes.
source: CRI Advisory Circular A2: Rhinoceros Beetle Management

filename: Removing a live adult black beetle feeding inside the young palm using a metal hook.png
description: Mechanical control of Black beetle Oryctes rhinoceros. Extracting adult beetle from feeding holes in young palm crown using a flexible hooked iron wire metal hook. Pest extraction technique.
caption: Manual removal of an adult Black Beetle from the palm crown using a iron wire hook.
source: CRI Advisory Circular A2: Rhinoceros Beetle Management

caption: Protective netting wrapped around young palm bud to prevent Black Beetle entry.
source: CRI Advisory Circular A2: Rhinoceros Beetle Management

source: CRI Advisory Circular A3: Red Palm Weevil Control

filename: Pheromone trap installed in coconut plantation.png

source: CRI Advisory Circular A3: Red Palm Weevil Control

description: Synthetic aggregation pheromone lure dispenser vial Ferrolure+ 700 mg for Red palm weevil Rhynchophorus ferrugineus attract and kill trapping system.
caption: Aggregation pheromone lure vial used inside Red Palm Weevil traps.

description: Controlled-release gel formulation aggregation pheromone dispenser for attracting Red palm weevil pests in coconut fields.
